subject: IN ACCORDANCE WITH COUNCIL DECISION (CFSP) 2021/908, ACFT
text:
A2931/26 NOTAMR A1633/26
Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/BO /E /000/999/3705N02445E341
A) LGGG B) 2608180905 C) 2611182359
E) IN ACCORDANCE WITH COUNCIL DECISION (CFSP) 2021/908, ACFT 
OPERATED BY BELARUSIAN AIR CARRIERS, INCLUDING AS A MARKETING 
CARRIER, ARE PROHIBITED TO LAND IN, TAKE OFF FROM OR OVERFLY THE 
TERRITORY OF THE HELLENIC REPUBLIC. EMERG, HUM AND HOSP FLT ARE 
EXEMPTED.
